issues.location: proper-inclusion proof for KD inside KT
issues.finding: The source writes KT proves Log{D}, a logic-system macro, while the cited result says KT proves the D axiom. The proof needs that axiom to establish that every KD theorem belongs to KT.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use the axiom macro Ax{D} as the provability conclusion in the target proof.

issues.finding: The nonprovability theorem writes Log{4} and Log{5} as its conclusions, but the proof exhibits instances of the 4 and 5 axiom schemata that fail in a KTB model. Those conclusions must use axiom macros.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use Ax{4} and Ax{5} after the two nonprovability symbols in the target theorem.

translation_treatment: Translated the countermodel arguments and captions, using axiom macros for D, 4 and 5 at the three affected provability claims.
